summary: Frontend-only end-to-end regression of RCC Leads Closer flow on https://lead-caller-pro.preview.emergentagent.com after iteration-3 fixes. ALL 13 scenarios from the review_request PASSED in a single clean run. The three fixes applied by E1 are confirmed working: (1) CloserDashboard onLogout now navigates synchronously to /login after clearing auth state, (2) StatusUpdateDialog Popover is controlled via dateOpen state and onSelect commits setDate before closing so the follow-up date propagates into Save, and (3) Call button is a real <a href='tel:...'> with data-testid=call-button-<id>. Backend follow_up_today filter behaves correctly for closer role (Lead B visible, Lead A hidden). No regressions observed.

critical_code_review_comments: CloserDashboard still polls /api/leads every 5s on an interval; consider cancelling when dialog is open or moving to SSE/websocket for efficiency (non-blocking).

StatusUpdateDialog resets its internal status/date only on mount; if the same dialog is reopened for a different lead it relies on parent unmount/remount via key=lead.id — currently works because `selected && <StatusUpdateDialog ... />` unmounts, but worth adding an explicit key or useEffect reset on lead.id for robustness.
a11y: Add DialogDescription id + aria-describedby on StatusUpdateDialog to silence Radix console warning.
Tel: handler calls api.patch in fire-and-forget (.catch(()=>{})); consider surfacing errors via toast so closers know if the status transition to 'called' failed.
